1. On the local machine, use `Bash` to base64 encode the file and split into chunks: `base64 -w0 <file> | fold -w 4000 > /tmp/transfer_chunks.txt`

3. Read each chunk with the `Read` tool (using offset/limit to read one line at a time)
4. For each chunk, use `ssh_execute` to write it:
   - First chunk: `printf '%s' '<chunk>' > /tmp/transfer.b64`
   - Subsequent chunks: `printf '%s' '<chunk>' >> /tmp/transfer.b64`
5. After all chunks: `base64 -d /tmp/transfer.b64 > <remote_path> && md5sum <remote_path>`
6. Verify md5 matches
